Zivarnet Full Archive — part 15 — source: https://www.zivarnet.top/ (fetched via mirror https://www.myf2ms.top/)

NOTE: These are mostly HARDsub files (Persian subtitle burned in, "زیرنویس فارسی چسبیده بدون حذفیات"), grouped under SoftSub here ONLY so the existing Family Night parser (which looks for SoftSub / Dubbed) reads them. Links labelled Hardsub are burned-in; links labelled Dubbed are Persian-dubbed (بدون سانسور where the site says so); links under NoSub have no Persian subtitle at all. No playit (?playit=...) links are used — only direct download links (abrtech.top, resolving to mehracdn.com), verified no-login from a foreign IP: HTTP 200, Accept-Ranges: bytes, Range 206. Sizes are from HEAD Content-Length where the CDN node answered from this VM; links on the 7 CDN nodes that return HTTP 503 to foreign IPs carry NO size here (the link is real — the user tested Zivarnet links working on his phone in Iran — only its size could not be verified from here). IMDb codes are included ONLY where the zivarnet page exposed an imdb.com/title/ link, except The 12 Dates of Christmas (tt39219651, from the earlier sample-file lookup). Encoder is "unknown" where the site says unknown — nothing invented. Series entries carry EVERY season and EVERY episode as listed on the site.
